programme.title: MP3: Mera Pehla Pehla Pyaar

programme.desc: Financially struggling, Vivaan and Siya are offered a chance to participate in a game show.
programme.title: Table No. 21

programme.desc: A man covertly saves money to fulfil his father's desire to go on the Char Dham Yatra. However, things change when his parents go missing due to heavy floods.
programme.title: Kanjoos Makhichoos

programme.desc: A stern fighter leads an isolated existence. However, a spirited woman enters his life and challenges his entire mindset.
programme.title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2

programme.desc: Chulbul Pandey, a corrupt police officer, leads a happy life with his wife and family. However, when his past enemy returns to wreak havoc, he must protect his loved ones from harm.
programme.title: Dabangg 3

programme.desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.
programme.title: RRR

programme.desc: The son of a wealthy man leaves his family post a misunderstanding. Later, when he saves a police officer from an evil man, this results in him earning the latter's wrath.
programme.title: Himmatwar

programme.title: Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1

programme.desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure kidnaps his family.
programme.title: Hit List

programme.desc: Two students with similar names but wildly different personalities end up switching their classes in college when the administration mistakenly switches their identity cards.
programme.title: Good Boy, Bad Boy

programme.desc: Raj, an out-of-luck architect, and Priya, an out-of-love social activist, find themselves connected in a strange way by destiny.
programme.title: Kismat Konnection

programme.desc: Ten-year-old Lakshmi dreams of winning a national-level dance competition, but she hesitates to participate when her single mother, Nandini, detests music and dance.
programme.title: Naach Lucky Naach

programme.desc: Tara and Sitara, siblings and small-time con-men, are on the run from a wanted criminal after they accidentally shoot at him. Soon they end up at the house of Major Ram Singh, where they take refuge.
programme.title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah

programme.desc: A bodybuilder and successful model plans revenge after his enemies inject him with a substance that deforms his body.
programme.title: I

programme.desc: A matchmaker sets out to teach Hoshiyar Chand a lesson while hilarity ensues when he asks Raju, a coolie, to pretend to be a millionaire.
programme.title: Coolie No. 1

programme.desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.
programme.title: Singh Is Kinng

programme.desc: Police officer Bajirao Singham and his competent colleagues must join hands and combine their efforts in order to save Bajirao's wife.

programme.title: Bruce Lee: The Fighter

programme.title: Rock On!

programme.title: EMI: Liya Hai to Chukana Padega

programme.desc: Dolly, a con woman, marries rich men only to run away with their wealth on the wedding night. After a series of such heists, a local policeman, Robin Singh, teams up with her victims to catch her.

programme.title: Chakra Ka Rakshak

programme.desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.
programme.title: Aitraaz

programme.title: Aparichit - The Stranger

programme.title: Raakaasa

programme.title: Luck by Chance

programme.title: Gulaal

programme.desc: After encountering an accident, Divya, a singer, is given the gift of being able to see the future. She decides to use her ability to help Inspector Rohan in finding a serial killer.
programme.title: Nazar

programme.desc: Kanav and Ashmeet's parents fix their wedding. However, he learns that she is interested in another man, whom her parents disapprove of, and decides to help them unite.
programme.title: Love Express

programme.desc: Daksh, a wealthy alcoholic, becomes infatuated with Jia, a dancer he meets outdoors. However, Daksh risks losing his fortune if he refuses to marry Anahita.
programme.title: Tumsa Nahi Dekha

programme.desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with Taman and Nimmi, their son and daughter respectively. However, strange occurrences start taking place and they must escape in order to survive.
programme.title: Bhoot Returns

programme.desc: An accident brings Karan and Pooja close to each other. When Karan finally decides to propose to her, he realises that destiny has other plans for them.
programme.title: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai

programme.desc: After a widower is forced into early retirement, he sets out to find another occupation to overcome his boredom. He meets a widowed boutique owner, and the two start to form a relationship.
programme.title: Sharmaji Namkeen

programme.desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.
programme.title: The Kerala Story

programme.desc: Raj, an out-of-luck architect, and Priya, an out-of-love social activist, find themselves connected in a strange way by destiny.
programme.title: Kismat Konnection

programme.desc: Mission Raniganj - 2023 - Mining engineer Jaswant Singh Gill leads a challenging rescue mission to save 65 miners trapped in a flooded coal mine.
programme.title: Mission Raniganj

programme.desc: Sunny is a resident of Rathodi, a village haunted by a resentful spirit. When a small mistake causes Sunny to be cursed, he approaches a ghost hunter to find a solution.
programme.title: Kakuda

programme.desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, journeys to Kashmir seeking inspiration and takes lodging in a mysterious guesthouse. He finds himself falling for Meera, the enigmatic owner, who harbours a dark secret.
programme.title: Khamoshiyan

programme.desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls in love with Sonia, the wife of a travelling millionaire, who convinces him to murder her husband. Later, Kabir is shocked to learn of her motivation for the murder.
programme.title: Jism

programme.desc: A teacher at a remote school in Kashmir finds himself falling in love with a woman he has never met.
programme.title: Notebook

programme.desc: Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.
programme.title: Deadline: Sirf 24 Ghante

programme.desc: A country boy falls in love with a rich man's daughter and moves to the city to be with her. However, the girl's father is determined to go to any length to separate the lovers.
programme.title: Deewaanapan

programme.desc: Ayan, a pharmaceutical salesman, decides to stand against his company after discovering that their new baby formula is responsible for the death of many babies.
programme.title: Tigers : Can a Salesman be a Hero

programme.desc: A housewife and caterer, Shashi, is usually mocked by her family for not knowing English. Her attempt to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and reassert her value as a mother and a wife.
programme.title: English Vinglish

programme.desc: King Kansa claims the throne of Mathura and kills off his nephews to prevent his death at one of their hands. However, the eighth child is whisked off to safety and grows up as Krishna.
programme.title: Gopal Krishna

programme.desc: After a six-year-old girl befriends a woman, they convince the girl's single father to reveal the story of her absent mother, changing all their lives in unexpected ways.
programme.title: Hi Papa

programme.desc: A team of Indian government officials must manoeuvre a high-stakes nuclear test in a town in Rajasthan without being detected by reconnaissance satellites or espionage networks.
programme.title: Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran

programme.desc: A thief pretends to be a policeman to extract a stolen diamond from the police headquarters. Although he becomes the ACP's favourite, a suspicious colleague tries to corner him with hilarious results.
programme.title: Chor Machaaye Shor

programme.desc: A young college student sets out to uncover the truth behind his parents' brutal killings in Kashmir, leading him to a web of lies and conspiracies.
programme.title: The Kashmir Files

programme.desc: Simran, who relocates to Seoul, is distraught when Daya, a gangster, re-enters her life. She has to make a choice between him and her lover Akash, who is a singer at an Indian restaurant.
programme.title: Gangster

programme.title: Last Christmas

programme.title: Fallen

programme.desc: The host delivers news alongside candid conversations with political figures and analysts, providing a thorough understanding of important social and political matters.
programme.title: Baat-Bebak

programme.desc: Two runaways fall in love and hope to live together. But with a crime boss and the police hot on their heels, the chances of a happily-ever-after appear slimmer than a blade of grass.
programme.title: Tamanchey: Pyar Mein Dil Pe Maar De Goli

programme.desc: Satyadev Singh, who leads a happy life with his wife and two sons, is killed by a corrupt collector, Bhim Singh. Years later, his sons, Sham and Ghansham, set out to avenge their father.
programme.title: Sham Ghansham

programme.desc: An investigative TV journalist and her cameraman set off to look into a tribal uprising and interview the leader. Before their journey ends, they find themselves falling in love with each other.
programme.title: Do Rahain

programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer with a vendetta charms a businessman's elder daughter and then kills her in a way that would make it seem like a case of suicide. He then plots to destroy the rest of the family.
programme.title: Baazigar

programme.desc: Jagjinder Joginder, a wedding planner, brings together the dysfunctional family of businessman Bipin Arora while making arrangements for his daughter's destination wedding in London.
programme.title: Shaandaar

programme.desc: Raj and Priya, a married couple, hire Madhubala, a prostitute, as the surrogate mother of their child. Trouble brews when Madhubala falls in love with Raj and insists on keeping the child.
programme.title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke

programme.desc: A top cop hires a man to guard his grandchild, unaware of the lurking threat. However, this protector is a hitman sent by kin to bump off the successor and grab the hefty estate.
programme.title: Jaan

programme.desc: When Ganga's husband abandons her, she embarks on a journey to Calcutta to find him and ensure her son has a better future. But she is cheated and forced to work in a brothel.
programme.title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili

programme.desc: When a criminal is sentenced to death by Judge Saxena, the gangster's brother takes revenge by killing the judge's family and his driver. Later, the driver's son embarks on a vengeful quest.
programme.title: Vijaypath

programme.desc: Mamta runs away with her son Vishwas to avoid any sort of contact with her criminal husband. Years later, Vishwas is unknowingly employed by his own father.
programme.title: Hum Pyar Tumhi Se Kar Baithe

programme.desc: Sweety runs away from her home to Seychelles in hopes of finding her father. However, things take a turn when she finds out that her father is staying there with another woman.
programme.title: Papa Kahte Hain

programme.desc: A group of four friends decide to play a prank involving the fake kidnapping of one of them and asking for ransom from her father. However, things become complicated when she actually ends up dead.
programme.title: Khiladi

programme.desc: Enraged by the police's indifference to his sister's murder, Bahadur becomes a dacoit to take the law into his own hands. He mistakenly kills a doctor, whose son swears to avenge his death.
programme.title: Aag Hi Aag

programme.desc: Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success.
programme.title: Avtaar

programme.desc: After being mercilessly beaten and abandoned to die, a young man is rescued by a band of dacoits, who nurse him back to health in their hidden lair.
programme.title: Dacait

programme.desc: Brigadier Suryadev Singh and Shivajirao Waghle, a police inspector, work together to track down a terrorist who plans to evade India.
programme.title: Tirangaa

programme.desc: Singh Saab is a responsible tax collector who believes in honesty, but Bhoodev, a conniving man, plots against him. Singh adopts a unique way to teach Bhoodev a lesson.
programme.title: Singh Saab the Great

programme.desc: After Vijay, a young army cadet, finds evidence against the corrupt officer, Gautam, he gets entangled in a never-ending battle with the police, which puts his career and his family in trouble.
programme.title: Salaami

programme.desc: To usurp the property from its ailing patriarch, a family hatches a plan and brings home an imposter as the lost grandson. However, the young man has plans of his own.
programme.title: Laalchee

programme.desc: Balwant, a truck driver, is driven into the underworld as he wants to take revenge on the owners of the trucking company for the death of his brother.
programme.title: Khatron Ke Khiladi

programme.desc: Inspector Jai balances working as a cop with taking care of his mother and a brother with developmental disabilities. But when he arrests a local don, he starts to fear for his family's safety.
programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara

programme.desc: Henna, a bubbly young woman based in a village in Pakistan, sets her heart on an endearing stranger who winds up there with serious injuries and no memory of his past.
programme.title: Henna

programme.desc: Twin sisters who are separated at birth, cause chaos when they swap places.
programme.title: Seeta Aur Geeta

programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.
programme.title: Ghatak

programme.desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.
programme.title: Gangaajal

programme.desc: Three friends, orphaned by an evil man, set out to take revenge for their father's murders. They are forced to navigate a complex web of deceit and stolen identities before they can reach their goal.
programme.title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja

programme.desc: Maddy has seven days to win Reena's affections before she finds out that he is not Rajeev, the childhood friend and prospective fiancé she has been expecting.
programme.title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein

programme.desc: When stars misalign, love blossoms between an astrology-obsessed idler and a headstrong fish heiress whose father will settle for nothing less than a hardworking son-in-law.
programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi

programme.desc: Brothers Suraj and Deepak work for the police as a havildar and a traffic constable respectively. However, they soon turn against each other when Deepak testifies in favour of a criminal.
programme.title: Muqabla

programme.desc: Hoping to make the world a better place for orphaned children, a compassionate street musician takes on a power-hungry crime boss with the help of a cloaking device.
programme.title: Mr. India

programme.desc: A man comes to America in order to find his brother who is wanted by the police. But his search forces him to get mixed up with a lady gangster that facilitates illegal underground fights.
programme.title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi

programme.desc: Police officer Raj Azad arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and prepares to interrogate him. However, his father-in-law mysteriously dies, after which he is blamed for his death and goes on the run.
programme.title: Indian

programme.desc: Ajit Rathod, a grieving policeman, vows to catch his wife's killer, terrorist Azhar Khan. He pursues Azhar with single-minded focus, overcoming all hurdles.
programme.title: Insan

programme.desc: Jai Kishen is an aspiring police officer who marries his girlfriend against his parents' wishes. Meanwhile, MLA Sadakhare hires a few men to carry out a bomb blast.
programme.title: Bomb Blast

programme.desc: Major Jaidev saves a politician from the clutches of a dreaded terrorist. However, the terrorist joins hands with his childhood friend Anjali to ruin his life.
programme.title: Pukar

programme.desc: Jai, an honest police officer, falls in love with Neha, Mr Singhal's daughter. However, he suspects Mr Singhal to be a criminal and tries to catch him red-handed.
programme.title: Barood

programme.desc: After her fiancé, Vijay is killed in a crash, a pregnant Pooja agrees to marry Amar, her childhood friend. However, her life takes yet another turn when Vijay returns to her life.
programme.title: Aarzoo

programme.desc: Raju, an upright union leader, can do anything at his wheelchair-bound mother's behest, even if it means breaking his own heart and giving in to a rude heiress.
programme.title: Laadla

programme.desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.
programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural

programme.desc: After inheriting a cursed ancestral palace in Mangalpur, Arjun hosts his sister Meera's wedding there. The decision unleashes a violent supernatural force tied to their family history.
programme.title: Bhoot Bangla

programme.desc: Ajay, an aspiring policeman, borrows money from a moneylender to pursue his dream. However, he is unable to repay the loan on time and decides to be a part of a kidnapping scheme.
programme.title: Apaharan

programme.desc: Raja and Reshma fall in love but Yash, Raja's childhood friend, likes Reshma so he kills Raja. Years later, the trio is born again to rewrite their stories.
programme.title: Hameshaa

programme.desc: In order to fulfil his dream of opening a free legal service for the poor, a lawyer and his girlfriend hatch a plan to rob a bank.

programme.desc: A police officer tries to expose the conspiracy behind the murder of a newspaper editor who gathered damaging evidence against various influential people.
programme.title: Jurm

programme.desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.
programme.title: Loha

programme.title: Parivaar

programme.title: Chehre Pe Chehra

programme.desc: Anand and Gopi, two brothers, are separated at birth. However, they cross paths later, when both of them fall in love with the same girl.
programme.title: Bikhre Moti

programme.desc: Nisha, a wealthy woman in charge of her family business, does not want to marry a rich man. She falls in love with Suraj Singh, a wedding singer and dancer, without realising that he has other plans.
programme.title: Baat Ban Jaye

programme.desc: This is Film - Drama Category.
programme.title: Saugat

programme.desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.
programme.title: Sheshnaag

programme.desc: An unsuspecting mill worker inadvertently becomes entangled in the shady activities of the mill owner and his associates.
programme.title: Ameer Aadmi Gharib Aadmi

programme.desc: Indrajeet, a retired police officer, sets out to take revenge on his ex-lover's brother and friends for murdering his adopted daughter and son-in-law.
programme.title: Indrajeet

programme.desc: Professor Khurana is recruited by a rich man to tutor his wayward son, Manjit. Later Khurana also takes on his friends, Vikram and Pawan. Unbeknownst to him, his students have a nasty plan for him.
programme.title: Bulundi

programme.desc: Chandan is found dead by his twin brother Trishul, who is a dacoit. In a bid to turn over a new leaf and leave the criminal life behind, Trishul assumes his brother's identity.
programme.title: Rakta Bandhan

programme.desc: When Anil, son of their absentee landlord, arrives in Mumbai and asks them to move out of his home, Laxmi and Jaya's lives turn chaotic.
programme.title: Kirayadar

programme.desc: Two fathers make arrangements and marry their young children. However, years later when the nuptials are almost finalised, the girl rejects the boy.
programme.title: Ponga Pandit

programme.desc: People from the state of Maharashtra interact in a series of stories that revolve around widespread corruption between individuals and organisations working in the cooperative sector.
programme.title: Laxmi

programme.desc: Ram's affair with Sadhana's close friend leads to their painful separation and a shattered marriage. Years later, their son Raju attempts to reunite them.
programme.title: Ek Hi Bhool

programme.desc: A man is wrongly accused and jailed for 18 years. After completing his jail term, he confronts the judge who convicted him and asks her to find the real culprits.
programme.title: Ladaai

programme.desc: Sooraj, the son of gangster Suryakant Pasha, kidnaps Radha, the daughter of the chief of police. They fall in love after spending some time together but the police and Pasha's men try to catch them.
programme.title: Hero

programme.desc: When Laxmi's servant is killed, she brings up his son Raju with her own children. When they get involved in some shady dealings, it's up to Raju to sort out the mess his family is in.
programme.title: Beta Ho To Aisa

programme.desc: Arjun, a short-tempered person, falls in love with Margaret, but her family is against their relationship. The couple elopes, but destiny forces the duo to commit suicide.
programme.title: Zehreela Insaan

programme.desc: Raj falls prey to an unethical lifestyle when a rich businessman, Sonachand, lures him into it. However, when he learns about Sonachand's unscrupulous ways, he decides to make amends.
programme.title: Shree 420

programme.desc: Young Kishan is separated from his family due to the evil intentions of his stepmother and her brother. Years later, he returns under a different identity.
programme.title: Takkar

programme.desc: Rajesh and Asha are compelled to elope as their families refuse to accept their love. However, they get mixed up with two rival groups who are in search of a tribal treasure.
programme.title: Daulat Ki Jung

programme.desc: Raja, an arrogant man, is in love with his servant's daughter, Radha. He is enraged to find that she loves Kishan, so he hatches a devious plan to get them married and then keep them apart.
programme.title: Amardeep

programme.desc: Accused of murder, Vijay Saxena, a union leader, confronts not only his employer, Dhanraj, but also the justice system, seeking to clear his name while continuing his fight for workers' rights.
programme.title: Jawab Hum Denge

programme.desc: After 14 years in an asylum, Sharada returns, shaking Nima and Balraj's life. Past secrets resurface, complicating relationships and disrupting the fragile balance of their marriage.
programme.title: Baseraa

programme.desc: Suraj, a singer, takes refuge from a storm in a rest house. During his stay, he has a strange feeling that he has been there before and recalls memories of being with a woman called Ratna.
programme.title: Mehbooba

programme.desc: Sher Khan, a criminal, decides to rob a bank. However, his life takes a dramatic turn when he meets a kind-hearted taxi driver.
programme.title: Sadhu Aur Shaitaan

programme.desc: Ajit's perfect marriage to Shobha turns upside down after she starts behaving strangely with him and his mother, leading to a disturbed life.
programme.title: Chandan Ka Palna

programme.desc: Mohanlal, a musician and a thief, robs rich people and distributes the money amongst the poor. However, things take a turn when he falls for Sunita, a wealthy man's daughter.
programme.title: Amir Garib

programme.desc: This is TV Show - Entertainment Category.
programme.title: Amar Prem Nath

programme.desc: Bharat, a graduate and the eldest son of a poverty-stricken family, struggles to provide for his kin after his father's retirement.
programme.title: Roti Kapada Aur Makaan

programme.desc: Moti betrays his loyal wife and business partner, Majubee, to marry his true love, Phoolbanu. However, his selfish act unleashes unforeseen consequences that upend his life.
programme.title: Saudagar

programme.desc: Jai and Munish fall for the same girl, ruining their bond with each other. However, an unfortunate turn of events reveals the true nature of their friendship.
programme.title: Aadmi Aur Insaan

programme.desc: Ramu sets out on a path of revenge after his brother is framed in a rape and murder case.
programme.title: Daku Aur Jawan

programme.desc: Raj lives with his brother, Mohan, who has taken a vow of celibacy. Trouble brews when Neena, along with her son, walks into their house and claims that Mohan is the father of her child.
programme.title: Ek Nari Ek Brahmachari

programme.desc: Following the murder of a chief minister, an assassin breaks into a house for refuge, where he discovers and captures a young woman who uses a wheelchair.
programme.title: Andha Yudh

programme.desc: Sophia is engaged to millionaire Karan who is completely in love with her. However, when she meets her true love, Vicky, and starts seeing him secretly, her relationship with Karan suffers.
programme.title: Naqaab

programme.desc: A farmer wants to build a hospital in his village, but is at odds with a landlord who wants to build a theatre on the same land. To get him out of the way, the landlord frames the farmer for murder.
programme.title: Mulzim

programme.desc: Radha marries a kind-hearted Govind who is paralysed due to an accident. Though Govind highly respects his uncle and aunt, a property dispute forces them to live like strangers under the same roof.
programme.title: Khandan

programme.desc: A forest ranger joins hands with locals to prevent large-scale poaching that is prevalent in the nearby forests. However, his efforts infuriate a poaching baron who vows to exact revenge.
programme.title: Dost

programme.desc: After being humiliated by an autocratic landlord, a temple priest kills himself. Later, the priest's son returns to the village seeking revenge.
programme.title: Himmatwala

programme.desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.
programme.title: The Kerala Story

programme.desc: Ramlal, a widower, struggles to find suitable grooms for his daughters and to control his son's film obsession. To make matters worse, one of his former employees launches a protest against him.
programme.title: Pyar Kiye Jaa

programme.desc: The shadows of shared familial discord hang heavy over the blossoming friendship between two young men, Vicky and Arjun, after they learn that they are long-lost cousins.
programme.title: Vijay

programme.desc: When Sadhana marries Deepak, her manipulative mother urges her to harass her mother-in-law. Subsequently, she also meddles in her son's marriage, turning their lives into a web of misery.
programme.title: Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi

programme.desc: Ashok, a salesman, is in love with Ashoo and wants to marry her. However, things take a turn when his brother kidnaps Ashoo.
programme.title: Dil Ne Phir Yaad Kiya

programme.desc: Ravi Kapoor, a police officer and Sonu Dada, a former criminal, join hands together to take down a notorious gangster, Chandi Das.
programme.title: Nafrat Ki Aandhi

programme.desc: Petty crooks Ahmed and Mohan decide to change their ways after meeting the virtuous Kabir Das. However, when Kabir is implicated in a murder case, the duo decides to help him but gets into trouble.
programme.title: Immaan Dharam

programme.desc: When his parents are killed by three men, Amar, Akbar and Anthony, Vijay teams up with a forest officer who was framed in a murder case to avenge their deaths.
programme.title: Andhaa Kanoon

programme.desc: After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight.
programme.title: Naina
